hypotheses.I0_exact_differential_composition: The difference of two all-attention recurrences matches the difference of independent autograd gradients to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.I1_near12_interaction_gradient: The difference of next-twelve programs reaches median cosine at least 0.80 in every layer/pair cell.
hypotheses.I2_near12_interaction_tail: The next-twelve differential program reaches Q10 cosine at least 0.50 in every cell.
hypotheses.I3_near12_recovers_interaction_support: Median exact top-64 support Jaccard is at least 0.40 in every cell.
hypotheses.I4_exact_interaction_patch_has_finite_di: The exact differential-gradient selector has positive finite Möbius effect on at least 75% of sites in every cell.
hypotheses.I5_near12_retains_interaction_effect: The next-twelve selector retains at least 70% of the exact-selector mean finite Möbius effect in every cell.
